verdict.rationale: BILL offers event-driven building blocks: webhook subscriptions for S&E, AP, and AR events (capped at 10 per organization), custom bill approval policies that set rules for which bills need approval and by whom, and vendor autopay that pays automatically when a bill is created. Beyond webhooks, though, there is no evidence of a general user-defined rule engine for Spend & Expense, and most of the documented rules are AP-specific. Missing for 10: a native configurable event→action rule builder for Spend & Expense, documentation of rule conditions and actions beyond approvals and autopay, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
